correctness.rationale: For homogeneous real weighted l1 variation on the seven-vertex two-level binary tree, integration identifies gradients modulo constants with weighted l1^6. Any linear trace right inverse gives a projection of the six-dimensional gradient space; averaging under root-preserving automorphisms cannot increase its norm, and leaves one scalar mixing parameter t. The exact root- and leaf-edge columns have norms A=t+2(1-t)/rho and B=(3+(rho-1)t)/2 for 0<=t<=1. Clipping off [0,1] decreases both absolute column norms. Their minimax yields the three branches at rho=1,4/3, and differentiation gives unique interior maximum at rho=4-2sqrt(2). I independently reconstructed all six gradient columns using rational leaf traces and verified the maximum at nine rational weights; no appeal to old PASS or a finite simulation as proof.
